did: I found why a pull down on the old phone stormed home and why pages stayed stale until a restart, and fixed both. A pull now joins the work already under way instead of starting it again, and the phone paces every request to home on one budget that a restart no longer refills. When home says it is busy, every request waits it out, each home's wait is its own, and the phone slows to home's rate. Nothing a pull waits on can hang it now, and a pull re-reads Takes, Needs your attention and Ideas on home. The ledger now records that home answers every request within 8 seconds, busy rather than silent. Four of home's tab write handlers now answer busy too, and the ledger says so. A lane's background sync that a trip home cut short now finishes once the app is back, instead of waiting for the next pull.

calls.title: How many requests the phone sends home at once
options: a burst of 20, kept across page loads
a burst of 49, kept across page loads
a burst of 10, kept across page loads
a burst read from home's own word on its limit, once home says it
calls.why: Twenty fits under any two-digit limit home may keep, and keeping it across page loads means closing and opening the app no longer hands it a fresh burst.
calls.undo: Change BURST in the home link's pace, or stop keeping it in the phone's storage.

calls.title: After home says too many requests, the phone keeps home's slower pace for a day
options: learn from home's wait, kept a day
learn from home's wait for the page load only
never learn: wait out each one and go on at the usual pace
calls.why: A home whose limit is lower would otherwise be stormed again after every wait; home's real limit asks for one second, from which the phone learns nothing.
calls.undo: Shorten how long the pace keeps what it learned, or stop it learning.

calls.title: A pull while the background work is already running joins it
options: ask one run after the run under way
join only a run that has not sent anything yet
calls.why: On the slow phone the first run is still going when the finger lands, and a second full run was the storm; you asked for repeated pulls to collapse into the one refresh in flight.
calls.undo: Make a pull ask a run after the one under way.

calls.title: A pull on Takes on home or Needs your attention stops a take that is playing
options: read again as Try again does, stopping what plays
skip the pull's read on that screen while a take plays
read again and keep the take playing across the new list
calls.why: Try again already stops it, and keeping it playing would need both screens' lists to leave playback alone.
calls.undo: Skip the pull's read on those screens while a take plays.

calls.title: A pairing that finds home overloaded says home is busy
options: its own failure, saying the host is busy for a moment
say it as too many tries, wait a minute
leave it as passkey sign-in not set up
calls.why: Not set up is untrue of a busy home, and too many tries blames you for a home that is full.
calls.undo: Drop the busy pairing failure, and an overload reads as not set up again.

left: Fitting the phone's pace to the limit home reports is unblocked now that the route snapshot (#3083) is on main, and not started.
The one planner for everything a screen asks of home is not started; it is a story.
The pace is one per phone, not one per home (#3132), and a pull that joins a long run says it couldn't read while that run is still reading (#3140); both are stories.
The root knip findings no check reads are filed, not fixed (#3130).
